critical_code_review_comments: profile.tsx line 88 sends `experience_level: experienceLevel || null` on save. Backend filters None fields (line 674 server.py) so an intentional clear (deselecting the chip) will NOT be persisted server-side. Consider sending empty string instead, or handle explicit null clear in backend. Non-blocking for this iter's scope.

server.py update_me uses `{k: v for k, v in body.model_dump().items() if v is not None}` so any field cannot be cleared to null via PUT. This is a general pre-existing limitation, not introduced by iter 23.
